description: This file defines a class HTMLPurifier_Filter_YouTube which extends a filter class for HTML purification. The class provides methods to process HTML code by filtering and embedding YouTube videos securely, transforming URLs into embedded objects.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Filter_YouTube
classes.description: A filter class that processes HTML to embed YouTube videos, transforming object/embed tags into safe embedded content and vice versa.

methods.name: preFilter
methods.description: Transforms YouTube object tags into span elements with a specific class for further processing.

methods.name: postFilter
methods.description: Replaces span elements containing YouTube URLs with embedded object tags.

methods.name: armorUrl
methods.description: Sanitizes URLs by replacing double hyphens with a safe HTML character code.

methods.name: postFilterCallback
methods.description: Constructs the embedded Flash object for YouTube videos from sanitized URLs.
